column1: # Reviewed exceptions to the environment-portability rules R1-R4.
# Columns, separated by TABs: rule, path glob, regex that must match the
# reported line, and the reason. A reason is one of:
#   recorded provenance of an accepted artifact
#   fixture for a parser or validator
#   project signing identity (the bundle identifiers that the Xcode
#     projects, the Kernarium runtime framework and the static framework
#     template track by decision; the signing team is never tracked)
# An entry that matches nothing fails the test, so the list cannot rot.
# Private tokens belong to the local denylist (R5), never to this file.
